decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Unnumbered Existing Block received on 27/03/2017, Unnumbered Site Location Plan received on 27/03/2017, Technical Inspection Report (Rev G) produced by Babatunde Dawodu dated 26 March 2017 and received on 27/03/2017, Heritage Statement (statement of significance and impact assessment) produced by Babatunde Dawodu dated 25 March 2017 and received on 27/03/2017, Photograph of Cranford Village Lock Up (unnumbered) produced by Babatunde Dawodu and received on 27/03/2017, Memo produced by Babatunde Dawodu dated 26 March 2017 and received on 27/03/2017, Email from Timber Rot Expert provided by Babatunde Dawodu dated 14 March 2017 and received on 27/03/2017, Revised Estimate for Conservation Works produced by Matt Nation of Taylor Pearce Limited dated 10 February 2017 and received on 27/03/2017 & Email Correspondences with Gareth James (Senior Transport Projects Officer) provided by Babatunde Dawodu dated 29 November 2016 and received on 27/03/2017. Structural Engineer's Report 19587 Cranford Lockup produced by Hockley & Dawson (consulting engineers) dated April 2017 and received on 21/04/2017 & Structural Engineer's Sketch 19587 (SK01) produced by Hockley & Dawson (consulting engineers) date 19 April 2017 and received on 21/04/2017.) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any internal/external feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings.
description: Repairs and maintenance to lock-up building (listed building consent)
